patterns.note: Content sections are presented on a dark, full-bleed background, with text and images centered within a clear, consistent maximum width.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal/black and off-white is accented by a warm, muted golden-orange for headings and key calls to action.
Elegant, large serif typography is used for primary headings and display text, providing a luxurious feel, while body text uses a clean, highly legible sans-serif.

The main navigation bar transitions from transparent to a solid dark background and becomes sticky upon scroll. The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a different rate than the overlaying text, and large text elements reveal from the bottom as the user scrolls down.
Service description sections consistently feature a bold, left-aligned heading, a descriptive paragraph, and a supporting black-and-white image positioned below the text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that dynamically changes its background from transparent to a solid dark color when the user scrolls past the hero section, ensuring continuous navigation visibility. Scroll-triggered animations are used to create a sense of depth in the hero by parallaxing the background image against the main headline. Additionally, large text overlays and content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up or fade-in effect as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.

Full-bleed, high-quality black-and-white photography is used extensively as background imagery for content sections, often with a subtle dark overlay to maintain text contrast and a sophisticated aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a luxurious character, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: minimal rounding on interactive elements like buttons and modals, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy: generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero area, contributing to a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-contrast black and white photography, paired with a rich golden-orange accent and elegant serif typography, creates a sophisticated and luxurious brand identity. The subtle parallax and scroll-triggered text reveals add a dynamic, premium feel without being distracting.
